detail: Full summary: Of the 217 placeholder options, hand-labelling found 153 SENSIBLE (70.5%), 60 NONSENSE (27.6%), 4 DEGENERATE. So extraction is mostly right — the dominant defect was never bad option names but the fabricated reason attached to all 217.
